title: Two-element localization short exact sequence
statement: Let C be a small site with topology J and sheaf of commutative rings R [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For U in C and f,g in R(U), set h=f+g and L(t)=O_U[1/t], using the sequential-colimit construction [def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-section-localization]. There exist module-sheaf maps i:L(h)→L(fh)⊕L(gh) and p:L(fh)⊕L(gh)→L(fgh) with i followed by p zero and forming a short exact sequence.

proof.text: In each section ring localized at h=f+g, the images of f and g generate the unit ideal because f/h+g/h=1. Standard-cover gluing gives injectivity and middle exactness of the diagonal and difference sequence.

proof.text: For surjectivity write z/(fg)^n with n positive. Expanding (f/h+g/h)^(2n-1)=1 gives u*f^n+v*g^n=1. The pair (v*z/f^n,-u*z/g^n) has difference z/(fg)^n. These sectionwise maps commute with restrictions.

proof.text: Sheafify the exact sequence; exact module sheafification preserves short exactness. Identify iterated localizations with product localizations and the fraction model with the sequential-colimit model by x at stage n mapping to x/t^n. This also handles h=0, when all three terms are zero.

lean.statement:
theorem ringedSite_localization_sum_sequence
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) (U : C) (f g : R.obj.obj (op U)) :
    let R₀ := (sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R
    let L := fun t : R.obj.obj (op U) ↦ ringedSiteSectionLocalization R₀ U t
    ∃ (i : L (f + g) ⟶ L (f * (f + g)) ⊞ L (g * (f + g)))
      (p : L (f * (f + g)) ⊞ L (g * (f + g)) ⟶ L (f * g * (f + g)))
      (hip : i ≫ p = 0), (ShortComplex.mk i p hip).ShortExact
